integrity.degree_basis: The degree formula is reconstructed from the type-D_n Weyl dimension product for the Plücker weight omega_2.
integrity.euler_basis: The Euler characteristic is the number of Schubert cells, computed as a Weyl-group quotient.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1109.6669 gives v1 at 2011-09-29 20:42:50 UTC.
integrity.inequality_basis: An exact consecutive ratio reduces strict monotonicity to a positive cubic polynomial for n>=4.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The arXiv record for 1109.6669 lists primary MSC 14N15.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the two-plane family OG(2,2n) in the Plücker embedding.
Only projective degree and ordinary topological Euler characteristic are compared.
An equivalent unindexed or folklore comparison remains a residual originality risk.
title: Plücker degree dominates Euler characteristic for even orthogonal two-plane Grassmannians
